usage.text:
Usage: ot [options] Commands: daemon Start the OTheater daemon in this terminal backup Make a backup of the data now restore Put a backup back (the daemon must be stopped) directives [...] Orders (the daemon must be stopped); actions: list, show , add , extend , suspend --scenario [text], revoke --reason chat Talk to the Director of a repository (the daemon must be running) profile [...] Accounts of the clients (the daemon must be stopped); actions: add , list, drain /, remove / executor [...] Executors of the models (the daemon must be stopped); actions: models , add , list, check [id], remove Options: --data-dir Data directory (default: OT_DATA_DIR, else the user data folder) -h, --help Show this help -v, --version Show the version Options of "ot directives": --scenario Local order for this scenario (without it, add makes a global one) --kind instruction (default), rule or suspension --role Only for this role (repeat it for more roles) --rule-key --rule-value The configuration key a rule overrides, and its value --suspends The global order a suspension takes out of the scenario --replaces Revoke this order and put the new one in its place --from --until --for Validity (YYYY-MM-DD [HH:mm]; 30m, 2h, 3d) --forever extend: take the end away --reason revoke: why --all list: also expired and revoked orders Options of "ot chat": --repo The repository (default: the current folder) --base The branch plays start from and deliver to (default: main) --name A name for the scenario (default: the folder name; a chat is identified by it) --type project (default, needs a repository) or chat (a generic chat, no repository) --new-project Create the project in --repo (a folder that does not exist or is empty) with the structure of the software profile Options of "ot profile": --kind add: token_plan (default, a subscription) or api (a key) --provider

add: the provider of the account (default: anthropic for claude-code, openai for codex) --api-key-env add --kind api: the NAME of the environment variable that holds the key (never type the key as an argument) --api-key-stdin add --kind api: read the key from the first line of the standard input --accept-notice add: go on after the notice about a second subscription account of the same provider --client list: only this client --all list: also the removed profiles --check-login list: ask each client whether the profile has a login --json Print JSON instead of text Options of "ot executor": --effort add: low, medium or high (default: what the catalog suggests) --family add: the family (provider) of a model whose catalog gives none --as add: the name of the model inside the Executor id (default: derived) --local-url add: URL of the local model server (default: the one in the catalog) --local-server add: llama-cpp (default) or ollama --role [:] add: also put it in this role, at position n (repeat it for more roles) --test-session add: run the short test session (it calls the model); --no-test-session skips it --dry-run add: report the fields and the checks, write nothing --profile list: only the Executors of this profile --all list: also the removed ones In the chat, "/attach " attaches a file (copied; "/attach --ref " keeps it in place): the next message you send names it as A for the Director. Exit codes: 0 success, 1 the command failed, 2 wrong usage.
usage.missingBackupPath: "ot restore" needs the backup folder to restore.
usage.noInput: "ot chat" needs a place to read the messages from.
usage.missingDirectivesAction: "ot directives" needs an action: list, show, add, extend, suspend or revoke.
usage.directiveNeedsId: This action needs the order id (for example O1).
usage.directiveNeedsText: "ot directives add" needs the text of the order.
usage.directiveNeedsScenario: "ot directives suspend" needs --scenario <id>: the scenario that stops following the order.
usage.directiveKind: --kind must be instruction, rule or suspension.
usage.directiveTooMany: Too many arguments for this action of "ot directives".
usage.missingProfileAction: "ot profile" needs an action: add, list, drain or remove.
usage.profileTooMany: Too many arguments for this action of "ot profile".
usage.profileNeedsClientName: "ot profile add" needs the client and the profile name (for example: claude-code work).
usage.profileNeedsProvider: "ot profile add" needs --provider <provider> for this client.
usage.profileApiNeedsKey: An API profile needs the key: --api-key-env <NAME> or --api-key-stdin.
usage.profileNoInput: "ot profile add --api-key-stdin" needs a place to read the key from.
usage.profileNeedsId: This action needs the profile id (<client>/<name>, for example claude-code/work).
usage.missingExecutorAction: "ot executor" needs an action: models, add, list, check or remove.
usage.executorTooMany: Too many arguments for this action of "ot executor".
usage.executorNeedsProfile: "ot executor models" needs the profile id (<client>/<name>, for example opencode/local).
usage.executorNeedsModel: "ot executor add" needs the profile id and the model (for example: opencode/local minimax/MiniMax-M2).
usage.executorNeedsId: This action needs the Executor id (<model>-<effort>@<client>/<profile>).

daemon.running: OTheater daemon running (pid {{pid}}), data in {{dataDir}}. Press Ctrl+C to stop.
daemon.vaultLocked: The vault is locked: no master password was given, so secrets are not available.

backup.daemonRunning: The daemon is running on this data directory: the copy is made from the database file and no event is recorded.

restore.daemonRunning: The daemon is running on this data directory. Stop it before restoring.
restore.keptDatabase: The previous database was kept as {{path}}.
restore.keptScenarios: The previous scenarios folder was kept as {{path}}.

chat.noDaemon: No daemon is running on this data directory (or its Producer channel is off). Start it with "ot daemon".
chat.opened: Chat open on scenario {{scenarioId}}. Type a message and press Enter.
chat.waitingFor_budget: waiting for the spending cap of {{profiles}}
chat.waitingFor_no_slot: waiting for a free slot on {{profiles}}
chat.menu:
Play {{playId}} needs you: {{reason}}
Type one of: {{options}} (after redefine_need, the new need; after the others, an optional reason).
chat.question: The Director asks: {{question}}
chat.badOption: That is not one of the options. Type one of: {{options}}.
chat.leftPending: Something still waits for your answer. It stays in the daemon: run "ot chat" again to answer it.
chat.attached: Attached as {{id}}: {{name}} ({{mime}}, {{size}} bytes). It goes with your next message.
chat.ideaUsage: Usage: /idea [--area <area>] <text> | /idea list | /idea drain | /idea discard <id> <reason> | /idea defer <id> <reason> | /idea requeue <id>
chat.ideaHeld:
The idea queue stopped: {{what}} ({{reason}}).
  It stays stopped until you type /idea drain, /idea requeue <id> or add a new idea.
chat.ideaHeldWhat_author_failed: the Author could not group the ideas
chat.ideaHeldWhat_author_left_all_out: the Author left every idea out of the group
chat.ideaHeldWhat_play_not_opened: the play of the group did not open
chat.ideaHeldWhat_play_ended: the play of the group ended without delivering (play {{playId}})
chat.ideaGroupOptions: Type: approve | edit <new need> | keep <ids in order> | refuse [reason].
chat.ideaGroupBad: That is not one of the options. Type: approve, edit <new need>, keep <ids> or refuse [reason].

system.handoff: System: attempt {{attemptId}} passed the baton from {{from}} to {{to}} ({{cause}}); the work goes on from the saved state.

recovery.title: System: the daemon restarted and reconciled this scenario.

directives.daemonRunning: The daemon is running on this data directory. Stop it to change orders here, or ask the Director to propose the change.

profile.daemonRunning: The daemon is running on this data directory. Stop it before changing profiles (the live control of a running daemon is not built yet).
profile.keyEnvEmpty: The environment variable {{name}} is empty or not set; no key to store.
profile.keyStdinEmpty: The standard input has no key on its first line.
profile.needsNotice: Another subscription account of {{provider}} is already registered ({{existing}}). OTheater does not check whether the terms of the provider allow more than one subscription account: read them before going on. Nothing was made. To register this profile anyway, run the command again with --accept-notice.
profile.noticeAccepted: Notice accepted and recorded: another subscription account of {{provider}} exists ({{existing}}).
profile.addedKey: The key is in the vault ({{backend}}); it is given only to the processes of this profile.
profile.addedLogin: Login: {{state}}. If it is not logged in, log in with the client itself, using this profile's folder.
profile.drained_finished: Profile {{id}} is draining: no new session; nothing was running.
profile.drained_handoff: Profile {{id}} is draining: no new session; {{sessions}} session(s) went back to the queue.
profile.drained_forced: Profile {{id}} is draining: no new session; {{sessions}} session(s) were stopped.
profile.drained_still_running: Profile {{id}} is draining: no new session; {{sessions}} session(s) are still running.
profile.dir_backup: Its folder was moved to the backup folder (profiles.drain.removed_dir: keep_backup).
profile.secretDeleted: The key was removed from the vault.

executor.daemonRunning: The daemon is running on this data directory. Stop it before changing Executors (the live control of a running daemon is not built yet).
executor.noModels: The catalog of {{profile}} lists no model.
executor.draft: Fields from the catalog: model {{model}}; name {{id}}; effort {{effort}} (the model accepts: {{efforts}}); provider {{provider}}; context {{context}}; reasoning {{reasoning}}; tool calls {{tools}}.
executor.needsInput: Missing: {{fields}}. Nothing was written; give it and run the command again.
executor.dryRun: Nothing was written (--dry-run). Executor {{id}} would be registered (provider {{provider}}).
executor.local_created: profiles.{{profile}}.local written: this model runs on this machine.
executor.cost: Price in the catalog (USD per million tokens): input {{input}}, output {{output}}. It is not stored here.
executor.placed_list: Put in the list of the role {{role}} (position {{position}}).
executor.placed_preset: The preset of the role {{role}} names it: it is in the role with no change to the file.
executor.askRoles: executors.on_register is "ask": it was written only in executors. To put it in a role run again with --role <role>[:<position>]; roles: {{roles}}.
executor.removedFromRoles: Taken out of the lists of the roles: {{roles}}.
executor.rolesEmptied: These lists became empty and were taken out (the role goes back to its preset): {{roles}}.
